Introduction

iii is a six-member girl group under Big Ocean ENM. Consisting of members Taeri, Hana, Eungi, Soobin, Huran, and Namkhing, they debuted on August 29, 2025 with the 1st single album 'RE:AL iii'. The group name 'iii' comes from the word 'in•spir•ation'.

iii released their pre-debut digital single 'Forbidden Midnight' on November 22nd, 2023. Vivi, Nicole and Evie left Big Ocean ENM and iii sometime in early to mid-2024. It is also believed Ahra and Yan left the group after it was revealed they would reform the group with new members in July 2025.

In 2025, members Namkhing, Soobin, Taeri, Eungi, Hana, and Huran were introduced from July 18th to the 27th.
